in_sync.title: Everything is in sync
in_sync.saved_state_size: This project's saved state is {{size}}. Above 2 MB it can no longer be published.

unpublished.never_published: The site hasn't been published from the Compositor yet.

check_failed.title: Couldn't check GitHub
check_failed.body: The Compositor couldn't reach your repository just now, so it can't tell whether anyone has committed to it since your last publish. You can keep editing.
check_failed.publish_line: Publishing waits until the Compositor can check GitHub.

first_publish.title: Not yet published from the Compositor
first_publish.body: Your first publish from the Compositor writes your site's files in its own layout. Nothing in them is lost.

out_of_sync.title: Changes on GitHub
out_of_sync.body: Someone committed to your repository after your last publish. Choose what to keep before you publish again.
out_of_sync.collab_body: Someone committed to the repository after the last publish. {{name}}, who coordinates this site, chooses which versions to keep. You can keep editing; publishing waits until then.
out_of_sync.collab_body_unnamed: Someone committed to the repository after the last publish. The person who coordinates this site chooses which versions to keep. You can keep editing; publishing waits until then.

repo_unavailable.title: Repository unavailable
repo_unavailable.body: Telar can't reach the repository for this project ({{repo}}). It may have been deleted, renamed, made private, or the app's access removed. Your work here is safe — it's stored separately from the repository.
repo_unavailable.collaborator_note: Ask the project's convenor to reconnect the repository.

halted.title: Saving has stopped
halted.body: This project's changes are no longer being saved. Anything you change now will not be kept.

reason.enforcement_failed: A change could not be undone safely.
reason.fence_refused: Another copy of the project took over saving.
reason.apply_failed: A change could not be applied safely.
reason.log_corrupt: The saved copy could not be read.
reason.bad_halt: The saved state could not be read.

halted.ask_convenor: Ask the project's convenor to restore it.
halted.restore_cost: Changes made since the last save were not saved and will be lost. Everyone editing will be reconnected.
halted.stale: The project changed while you were confirming. Check its state and try again.
halted.uncertain: The restore may not have completed. Check its state and try again.
halted.unreadable_state: The project's saving state could not be read just now.

repo_invitation.title: Repository invitation
repo_invitation.body: GitHub has sent you an invitation to this project's repository. Accept it here to finish joining.
repo_invitation.welcome_body: {{convenor}} added you as a collaborator. Accept the invitation to this project's repository to finish joining.
repo_invitation.welcome_email: GitHub is also sending you this invitation by email. Be sure to accept it, here or in that email.
repo_invitation.lapsed: Your invitation to the repository expired, so it can't be accepted. A convenor can send you a new one.
repo_invitation.changed: Your invitation changed, so nothing was accepted. Close this and open it again.
repo_invitation.fallback: We couldn't accept the invitation from here. You can accept it on GitHub instead.
